reason: The book is positioned defensively with 50% cash and bonds after the September momentum rotation from small-cap to mega-cap tech. While sentiment has shifted toward mega-cap tech strength (QQQ breaking to new highs post-correction), we experienced a major reversal just five trading days ago (Sept 21), and technical breadth remains weak with 60% of index members trading 20% below their peaks. The current allocation's 50% cash position preserves capital and maintains dry powder for the next significant move. The cost of churning the portfolio to chase the mega-cap tech bounce outweighs the benefit of repositioning ahead of an uncertain follow-through. We will reassess after seeing at least one week of follow-through on the mega-cap tech breakout through the end of September, when market structure and breadth dynamics will be clearer.
